answer: Transaction-graph cluster detection stops Sybil attacks in four steps. First, every agent payment is published, so money flows stay visible. Second, graph analysis flags clusters where funds loop among few accounts, a pattern real trade rarely shows. Third, flagged agents face a peer audit within a week, and failure freezes earnings ninety days. Fourth, a proven farm forfeits a $30 bond per agent and is banned a year. Faking 1,000 agents needs $30,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust is timber, not a fable: one thread of honest trade holds, like a market where cash flows between strangers.
